title: Missing test coverage for =CR/=LF split-escape edge case
description:
There is no test that asserts correct behavior when '=' appears immediately before CR, LF, or CRLF in a data line. The existing no_panic test at tests/no_panic.rs:56 has a line ending with '*=\n' but only checks 'must not panic' -- it does not assert the decoded result. The SizeMismatch error fires incidentally, masking the underlying corrupt-byte production.

Required tests (after fixing MIME-592.19): decode_line_eq_before_crlf_is_lone_escape asserting decode_line(b'*=\r\n') gives [0], and a full-decode test with a crafted article where an escape pair straddles a line boundary to confirm the fix handles real-world split-escape articles from non-Rust encoders.
